mapping: NEW states (F7: fx's two-bowl rule, k = 300+, 40 main; F6: fx's F6 rule + f6o's covers, k = 400+, 60 main), branches seed_base 14000000 + 1000 k; client seed 7, --bind track.  Models: frozen pi0.5 (PRIMARY; pp_serve_purify --model pi05 --mode intact --comp '' --seed 13, as SR 45) and frozen pi0 (SECONDARY; serve_guided --mode ours --seed 13, BACKBONE_CONFIG=pi0_libero, as SR 45.3 / 65).  Success = the BDDL goal.  Bootstrap over states (B = 2000, numpy default_rng(0), percentile 2.5 / 97.5); an F7 family = its two relational tasks on the same states, paired; K = the mean of K1t (F6 states) and K2t (F7 states), each task's states resampled separately in the same draw.  GATES per model: (floor, SR 50) TESTABLE iff I's K >= .70; (F7 family) TESTABLE iff U = the mean of I's two unique-name controls of the family >= .50 (fx's NO POWER rule, without the reference); (F6) TESTABLE iff I's F6_a >= .50 (f6o's NO POWER rule, without the reference).  A label on an untestable cell reads NOT TESTABLE with the rule's outcome descriptive.  REGISTERED CONTRASTS per model: (V1) RC - rgp on each F7 family (SP, NG): RC WINS iff lo > 0; RG WINS iff hi < 0; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE.  (V2) RC - rgp on F6_b: the same labels.  (V3) RC - I on each cell (SP, NG, F6_b): dF = RC - I on the cell, dK = RC - I on K: FIX WORKS iff dF lo > 0 AND dK lo > -.05; PARTIAL iff exactly one holds; FAILS iff neither (SR 62-69's rule); dK alone is labelled NON-INFERIOR iff lo > -.05, else NOT SHOWN.  PRIMARY: V1-V3 on pi0.5.  RECORDED (descriptive): the resolver's accuracy (rc, f7r: the resolved bowl is the referent, against the simulator); rgp's binding (the bound instance is the referent); registration error per entity (cm, against the simulator); the memory slot's record (mask IoU and centre xy error against the true plate), the latch step and painted pixels; ReGuide's plate-pose error held over the episode (registered vs true plate at the end); C = referent grasps among bowl grasps per arm and family (fx's C); per relational task, its own unique-name control (a task whose control is < .50 is flagged CEILING); rgp - I, f7r - I, mem - I, RC - f7r, RC - mem; ReGuide transports.  No reference planner is run (SR 55 / 65 ran none for ReGuide).
